split_definition.caveat: B_EH|20261105 was checkpointed at update 75 before this split existed; its accumulator could not be backfilled, so its split_from_update is 75 and the split covers updates 76-200 only.  Its dev_eval (80 worlds) is complete and is the comparable figure.
